src_architecture.path: Dynamic catch-all routing (Receives Storyblok story JSON, unwraps story.content.body, isolates DTO errors via Zod, deduplicates requests via React.cache, handles 404 vs 500 boundaries via handleStoryblokError, sanitizes route/query params, and renders full-width flex container without duplicate main landmarks)
Presentational and composite components with centralized index.ts barrel export (HeroSection, TabbedInterface, PromoBanner, LocalJobsGrid, MissionBanner, BlogGrid, BlogCard, JobLinkCard)
CMS-bound component wrappers and client-side bridge resolver (PageBlok, HomeContent)
Storyblok client initialization (storyblok.ts) with unified token extraction, pure diagnostic checks (getStoryblokConfigIssue), and virtual client intercept for offline CI fixture hydration
Data Transfer Objects, payload sanitization (sanitizeStoryPayload.ts), and centralized Storyblok error handling (storyblok/storyblokErrorHandler.ts)
Route and query parameter sanitization modules (sanitizeParams.ts)
Standardized CMS response fixtures (storyblok-fixture.json) for zero-egress CI/CD compilation and deterministic testing

cms_architectural_invariants.invariant: Decoupled Headless Contract: Storyblok owns zero HTML, CSS, or molecular components in production. It operates strictly as a decoupled JSON data store returning content arrays of typed bloks.

Zero Production Iframe: The application renders native Next.js Server Components. Iframes are strictly isolated to the Storyblok Visual Editor administrative preview (app.storyblok.com) via window.postMessage bridge listeners.
Presentation Sovereignty: All styling, fluid typography, WCAG 2.2 AA focus indicators, and layout constraints remain 100% under local Tailwind CSS v4 CSS-first token custody.

Offline CI Determinism: CI runners execute static generation and type audits against local fixture JSON, eliminating build-time network dependencies, API token exposure, and rate-limiting failure states.
